newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan boosts U.S./Australian wheat tender-agent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan boosts U.S./Australian wheat tender-agent.

text.p: Pakistan has amended its simultaneous U.S. and Australian wheat tenders to 450,000 tonnes each from 360,000 tonnes, its U.S. export agent said.
The tender was scheduled for February 16.
The delivery dates were also changed to February 25 to March 31 for both tenders, from the originally announced March 5-31.
All other terms and conditions of this tender will remain unchanged, the agent said.

The tender for U.S. wheat was for No. 2 or better soft white wheat in bulk, plus or minus five percent, buyer's option, under the U.S. Department of Agriculture's GSM-102 export credit guarantee program.
The tender for Australian wheat was for white milling wheat.
"The offers are to be received this Sunday and the commodity will be purchased on Monday," the agent said.
